hero_kpi_rationale: The extraordinary gain and the transformation of the financing model through the HDFS transaction in 2025 are the primary drivers of operational performance this year, despite the decline in motorcycle sales.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income declined to $338.7M in 2025 from $455.4M in 2024, due to lower motorcycle sales and tariff-related costs.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in net income in 2025

kpis.name: HDMC Segment Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the core motorcycle manufacturing segment.
kpis.description: The HDMC segment turned to an operating loss of -$28.7M in 2025 from +$277.8M in 2024, impacted by volume declines and tariffs.
kpis.signal: Major operating loss in core business

kpis.name: HDFS Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the motorcycle financing segment.
kpis.description: HDFS operating income doubled to $490.4M in 2025, driven by the sale of receivables and release of provisions.
kpis.signal: Surge in income due to HDFS transaction

kpis.name: Retail Motorcycle Sales (% change)
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year change in motorcycle sales to end customers through dealerships.
kpis.description: Global sales declined by 12.4% in 2025, with -12.9% in the United States and -11.5% internationally.

kpis.name: Tariff Cost
kpis.explanation: Total cost borne by the company due to customs duties.
kpis.description: The total cost of new or increased tariffs in 2025 amounted to $67M, with higher impacts expected in 2026.

kpis.name: LiveWire Operating Loss
kpis.explanation: Loss from the segment dedicated to premium electric motorcycles.
kpis.description: LiveWire's operating loss improved from $109.6M in 2024 to $75.0M in 2025, thanks to cost-saving measures.
kpis.signal: Reduced losses due to cost reductions

kpis.name: HDFS Transaction Gain
kpis.explanation: Gain realized from the sale of residual interests in financing receivables.
kpis.description: The sale of 95% of residual interests in financing receivables generated a gain of $27.9M.

kpis.name: Credit Loss Provision Release Benefit
kpis.explanation: Benefit resulting from the reduction of provisions following the sale of financing receivables.
kpis.description: The sale of $4.1B in receivables enabled a $191.4M release of credit loss provisions.

risks.title: Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Tariff costs increased by $67 million in 2025 and could reach $105 million in 2026. This directly affects production costs and the company's sales.

risks.title: Economic Environment
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable economic conditions have led to weaker demand for luxury products, including Harley-Davidson motorcycles. This directly impacts sales and profits.

risks.title: High Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: High interest rates negatively affect motorcycle sales and company profits, as consumers face higher financing costs.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the motorcycle market is rising, which could impact Harley-Davidson's market share and sales.

risks.title: Dependence on Financing
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on financing for its sales, making it vulnerable to fluctuations in interest rates and credit conditions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks that could compromise customer data confidentiality and damage its reputation.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks that could affect its sales and profitability.
